texts.en:
Detailed study has revealed that [From.GetName]'s magnetic field was so attractive to drones in orbit due to the unique frequency at which it oscillates. It just so happens that the planet's magnetosphere resonates at a rate that produces a focusing effect on the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] neural network.

Should we inhabit [From.GetName], any [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on the surface would be able to constantly enjoy the benefits of this magnetic resonance.

# 高强磁性 / Attractive Magnetism

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:380-400; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3866 (distar.100)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。宜居星球可能生成（1级，权重1），只对格式塔帝国（蜂巢/机械）生效，是“共鸣水晶”的格式塔版本。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on habitable planets (level 1, weight 1) for gestalt empires only (hive minds / machines); the gestalt counterpart of "Resonant Crystals".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.100“有益频率”：星球磁层的振荡频率恰好能让本帝国的神经网络更加专注。星球获得 good_vibrations 修正。

distar.100 "Conducive Frequencies": the magnetosphere oscillates at a frequency that focuses our neural network. The planet gains good_vibrations.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。

No empire-specific option differences.
